hooks.command: PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; node --no-warnings "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skill-watch.ts" prompt 2>/dev/null || NODE_OPTIONS= pnpm dlx tsx "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skill-watch.ts" prompt

PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; node --no-warnings "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skill-watch.ts" post-tool 2>/dev/null || NODE_OPTIONS= pnpm dlx tsx "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skill-watch.ts" post-tool
PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; node --no-warnings "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skill-watch.ts" stop 2>/dev/null || NODE_OPTIONS= pnpm dlx tsx "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skill-watch.ts" stop
